```{r}
library(shiny)

# Define the specific order of species
species_list <- c(
  "Dogs", "People", "Brown Pelican", "Cormorant", "Great Blue Heron", 
  "Great Egret", "Snowy Egret", "Black Turnstone", "Curlew", "Oystercatcher", 
  "Spotted Sandpiper", "Surfbird", "Wandering Tattler", "Whimbrel", "Willet", 
  "California Gull", "Unidentified Gull", "Juvenile Gull", "Tern", "Western Gull", 
  "Unidentified Bird (non-gull)", "Black Phoebe", "Say's Phoebe"
)

# --- UI Definition ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Shorebird Datasheet Entry 2.0.02"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 4,
      dateInput("date", "Survey Date:", value = Sys.Date(), format = "mm/dd/yyyy"),
      selectInput("zone", "Zone Class:",
                  choices = c("Select Zone", "I", "II", "III", "III Boulders", "III Rocky Outcrop")),
      hr(),
      h4("Species Counts"),
      lapply(species_list, function(s) {
        numericInput(inputId = paste0("spec_", gsub(" ", "_", s)), 
                     label = s, value = 0, min = 0)
      }),
      hr(),
      actionButton("submit", "Submit Full Sheet", class = "btn-primary", style="width:100%"),
      br(), br(),
      actionButton("reset", "Reset All to Zero", style="width:100%"),
      hr(),
      # Added the red "Remove" button here
      actionButton("removeLast", "Undo Last Full Submission", class = "btn-danger", style="width:100%")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      width = 8,
      wellPanel(
        span("Status: ", style = "font-weight: bold;"),
        textOutput("status", inline = TRUE)
      ),
      h4("Last 10 Rows in CSV File:"),
      tableOutput("fileDataTable"), 
      hr(),
      h4("Current Session History (Last 5 Species Submitted):"),
      tableOutput("dataTable")
    )
  )
)

# --- Server Logic ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  csv_path <- file.path(".", "Data", "shorebird_2025_2026.csv")
  refresh_file_view <- reactiveVal(0)
  session_log <- reactiveVal(data.frame())

  # 1. Submit Logic
  observeEvent(input$submit, {
    if (input$zone == "Select Zone") {
      output$status <- renderText("Error: Please select a Zone.")
      return()
    }
    
    new_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(species_list, function(s) {
      data.frame(
        SurveyDate = format(input$date, "%m/%d/%Y"),
        ZoneClass = input$zone,
        DataType = s,
        DataCount = input[[paste0("spec_", gsub(" ", "_", s))]],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
    
    tryCatch({
      if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
        write.table(new_rows, csv_path, sep = ",", col.names = FALSE, 
                    row.names = FALSE, append = TRUE, qmethod = "double")
      } else {
        write.table(new_rows, csv_path, sep = ",", col.names = TRUE, 
                    row.names = FALSE, append = FALSE, qmethod = "double")
      }
      
      output$status <- renderText(paste("Success! Added", nrow(new_rows), "rows to CSV."))
      session_log(rbind(new_rows, session_log())) 
      refresh_file_view(refresh_file_view() + 1)
      
      for(s in species_list) {
        updateNumericInput(session, paste0("spec_", gsub(" ", "_", s)), value = 0)
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      output$status <- renderText("ERROR: Ensure the CSV is closed!")
    })
  })

  # 2. Reset UI Button Logic
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    for(s in species_list) {
      updateNumericInput(session, paste0("spec_", gsub(" ", "_", s)), value = 0)
    }
    output$status <- renderText("All counts reset to zero.")
  })

  # 3. NEW: Remove Last Full Submission from CSV
  observeEvent(input$removeLast, {
    if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
      tryCatch({
        full_data <- read.csv(csv_path)
        num_to_remove <- length(species_list) # Currently 23
        
        if (nrow(full_data) >= num_to_remove) {
          # Keep everything EXCEPT the last 23 rows
          updated_data <- full_data[1:(nrow(full_data) - num_to_remove), ]
          
          # Overwrite the file with the new reduced data frame
          write.table(updated_data, csv_path, sep = ",", col.names = TRUE, 
                      row.names = FALSE, append = FALSE, qmethod = "double")
          
          output$status <- renderText("Success: Last full submission (23 rows) removed from file.")
          refresh_file_view(refresh_file_view() + 1)
        } else {
          output$status <- renderText("No data left in file to remove.")
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        output$status <- renderText("ERROR: Could not edit file. Is it open in Excel?")
      })
    }
  })

  # 4. Tables
  output$fileDataTable <- renderTable({
    refresh_file_view()
    if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
      file_data <- read.csv(csv_path)
      return(tail(file_data, 10))
    }
  }, rownames = FALSE)

  output$dataTable <- renderTable({
    head(session_log(), 5)
  })
}

# --- Run App ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
